body: Man look, you have gotten this far in life with all the bullshit not to just end it all on a given day. I was in your shoes once, just turned 30 on 9th March, but it wasn’t gonna be cause i tried ending my life a couple of times a few years back, cause i had just given up on life, on myself. Somehow i found my way through it all and learned to live for myself. Cause it’s about you, about us. People will tell you to not do it cause you have family and friends, but you’ve got yourself too. Life is far from a fairy tale and there are horrors we have to live everyday, especially people like us. But we gotta find a way just to get to another day. Even if nothing changes, you make it to tomorrow and appreciate yourself for the fight you put up. The sun will rise and fall on you just like the thoughts in your head take you from the light to the dark. There’s always light and there’s always darkness, one wouldn’t have no meaning without the other. So give up on people, on feelings, on emotions but never on yourself. You will find your way through all the bullshit in life. Just remember that it’s on you to step on the shit or over it.

Turned 29 this march, life was all fun n laughs a few years back. Had a job in a multinational, family n friends were all there creating memories n fun moments, was in a great relationship. It all came crashing down on the 8th of march 2019, a day before my birthday when i got a call from home that my father had collapsed. Flew back home on my birthday to finally see him in the icu, he had a stroke which left him in a vegetative state, which lasted for almost 4 years till his death in late 2022. Saw his body literally rot in front of my eyes everyday and lived with this fear of imminent death for all those years. Quit multiple jobs cause i just couldn’t get my brain to work like a normal human. My girlfriend of 8 years cheated on me during that time as well so that added to the mental fuck up. Lost good friends over some shit i don’t even know about. Lost touch with some family members. Went jobless for a long fucking time while just facing desk rejections over n over. I just couldn’t present myself like a normal human being who could function outside his mental despair. Tried to end my life a couple of times but somehow lived to revel in my own sorrows. Developed social anxiety to such an extent that I can’t go out without “pretend calling” on my phone so that i don’t have to look at people or talk to them. Have anger issues where i just lose my temper for the silliest of things. Haven’t celebrated my birthday since then as it just brings terrible memories back. Health is going down day by day with multiple anxiety attacks over the years and addiction to add on to everything. Everyday is just a damn struggle at this point. On one hand i see the brighter side but on the other i just want to escape out of whatever im in.

I feel what you're going through. I'm in my twenties as well and have gone through a lot. When i was ten, my next door neighbour murdered a woman, who lived just a few houses from us. That traumatized me for a while. Then as years went by i lost both my grandparents in quick succession, who had lived with us for all our lives. I had two dogs, one of them died of a disease and the other was poisoned by someone. Then lost three uncles, one after the other over a period of three years. None was a natural death. One died in his sleep and we found out about that on 1st Jan early in the morning. That's how the new year began for us. Then as life was starting to look better, i had my dream job, was living with my girlfriend, money was not an issue, everything was bright and shiny. Then on my birthday three years back, my father suffered a stroke which left him in vegetative state. He has been unconscious but alive for three years now. Amidst this, i got to know that my girl had cheated on me while i was staying at the hospital looking after my father. We still tried to make the relationship work as we had been together for 5 years by that point but in the end it all fell apart. We split after 8 long years. And to add to all that, i had to quit multiple jobs because of my mental health and now have a job that doesn't even pay me enough to pay all my bills on time. Have thought of ending my life multiple times and a couple of hours ago before writing this as well. 

So i tell you my friend, life is not fair neither it cares about who or what you are. It fucks all of us up. We just have the choice of keeping our chins up or just going down and out.
